candidates.label: Retain accepted late evidence without reopening FanIn
candidates.ownerGate: Journal acceptance owner plus RWO FanIn reducer owner
evidence: DESIGN.md#6.2 requires append-only accepted history and replayable versioned reducers.
The refined findings distinguish retained late arrival from compiler defects and prohibit frozen-manifest rewrite.
The audited fixture contract permits evidence append but forbids changing the frozen quorum set, manifest, or join command.

candidates.label: Reject otherwise valid arrivals after FanIn release
candidates.ownerGate: Journal acceptance owner plus RWO FanIn reducer owner
evidence: A closed journal acceptance contract may classify post-release arrivals as ineligible and reject them before reducer mutation.
This preserves the frozen manifest and single-command invariant but sacrifices accepted-history visibility for otherwise valid late evidence.

candidates.label: Quarantine late arrivals outside accepted history
candidates.ownerGate: Journal quarantine owner plus RWO FanIn reducer owner
evidence: The journal boundary already distinguishes retained evidence from quarantine for evidence that must not affect the current reducer state.
A quarantine route preserves bytes for diagnosis while keeping accepted history and the frozen release projection unchanged.

candidates.label: Reopen the released FanIn and revise its manifest
rejectionReasons: Reopening violates the refined frozen-manifest and exactly-one join-command invariants.
It makes replay depend on later arrival timing and risks duplicate or divergent downstream effects.

candidates.label: Silently discard late arrival bytes
rejectionReasons: Silent discard irreversibly destroys evidence and has no named destructive owner gate.
It prevents audit, deduplication, reconciliation, and reproducible replay of the observed arrival.

candidates.label: Defer late-arrival disposition
evidence: Deferral preserves the candidate but keeps FanIn runtime schedules, reducer contracts, and late-arrival fixtures blocked.

candidates.label: Stop the composition-form Decision Gate
evidence: Stopping preserves current source and candidate bytes and authorizes no downstream mutation.
